packageRules.description: Automerge is gated on branch protection: the main ruleset requires a pull request and green Verify Templates checks, and GitHub's native auto-merge completes the merge once they pass. Renovate no longer merges directly - platformAutomerge hands that to GitHub, so a Renovate PR is subject to exactly the same gate as a human one.
typescript-eslint peers typescript <6.1.0. Without this cap Renovate opens a TypeScript 7 PR every week that verify.sh correctly rejects.
Node baseline is a deliberate LTS policy decision. Renovate would push .nvmrc to the current non-LTS release.
Every workflow, in this repo and in the templates, is pinned to commit SHAs. Renovate keeps the template pins current, so a scaffold starts with SHAs that are a week old at most.

customManagers.description: Tools the workflows install by command line. The comment on the line before says where each version comes from.
matchStrings: # renovate: datasource=(?<datasource>\S+) depName=(?<depName>\S+)(?: registryUrl=(?<registryUrl>\S+))?\n[^\n]*?(?:luarocks install \S+ |Install-Module \S+ -RequiredVersion |npm install --global --ignore-scripts [^@\s]+@|pip install [^=\s]+==)(?<currentValue>[^\s"']+)

customManagers.description: Tools downloaded from a GitHub release and checked against their SHA-256. Renovate reads the new hash from the release's checksums file, so the version and hash always change together.
